top_band: green grass ground surface across rows 0-47
evidence: This is a terrain ground patch (4x3 tiles of grass). As a flat ground surface, a top-down plane filling all 48 rows with no front face is expected and valid.

style.evidence: The candidate uses 5 shades of green to draw grass tufts, which matches the palette depth of the reference grass. However, all 12 tiles in the 4x3 patch are identical repeats of a single 16x16 tile containing an unnatural, harsh diagonal slash/check-mark motif that repeats rhythmically, lacking the organic clustering and multi-tile variation seen in the Beodeul reference.
